_comment: Pipeline smoke test without any vendor app: four bundled placeholder programs (python3 -m cf.linux.placeholder_app) standing in for the three categories. Each shows a progress counter and writes it to /tmp/cf_placeholder_<id>.json, so you can verify that throttled apps keep progressing (slower) and never lose state. Works on any X11 session, including Xvfb + a window manager.

sim_download.cmd: python3 -m cf.linux.placeholder_app --app sim_download --title 下载占位 --cpu 0.3 --mem 250 --io-mbps 20

sim_push.cmd: python3 -m cf.linux.placeholder_app --app sim_push --title 推送占位 --cpu 0.1 --mem 150 --notify-every 15

sim_compute.cmd: python3 -m cf.linux.placeholder_app --app sim_compute --title 计算占位 --cpu 0.9 --workers 3 --mem 400
